rfmSegments.description: High recency, high frequency, and maximum spend. Loyal brand advocates.

sqlQueries.title: 1. Key Executive Business Metrics
sqlQueries.description: Calculates overall total revenue, total order volume, and Average Order Value (AOV).
sqlQueries.query:
-- Total Revenue, Total Orders & Average Order Value
SELECT 
    SUM(`Sale Price` * `Order Quantity`) AS Total_Revenue,
    COUNT(`OrderID`) AS Total_Orders,
    ROUND(AVG(`Sale Price` * `Order Quantity`), 2) AS Avg_Order_Value,
    ROUND(AVG(`Rating`), 2) AS Avg_Customer_Rating
FROM ecommerce_data
WHERE `Status` != 'Cancelled';

sqlQueries.title: 2. Revenue & Ratings by Product Category
sqlQueries.description: Groups all transactions by category, determining the revenue contribution and satisfaction score.
sqlQueries.query:
-- Revenue & Rating distribution across departments
SELECT 
    `Product Category`,
    SUM(`Revenue`) AS Revenue,
    COUNT(`OrderID`) AS Total_Orders,
    ROUND(AVG(`Rating`), 2) AS Avg_Rating,
    ROUND(SUM(`Revenue`) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(`Revenue`) FROM ecommerce_data), 2) AS Revenue_Share_Pct
FROM ecommerce_data
GROUP BY `Product Category`
ORDER BY Revenue DESC;

sqlQueries.title: 3. Top 5 Products per Category (CTE + RANK Window Function)
sqlQueries.description: Uses a Common Table Expression (CTE) and RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Product Category ORDER BY Revenue DESC) to identify category champions.
sqlQueries.query:
WITH product_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        `Product Category`,
        `Product`,
        SUM(`Revenue`) AS revenue,
        COUNT(`OrderID`) AS orders
    FROM ecommerce_data
    GROUP BY `Product Category`, `Product`
)
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT *,
           RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY `Product Category` ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rank_in_category
    FROM product_revenue
) ranked
WHERE rank_in_category <= 5
ORDER BY `Product Category`, rank_in_category;

sqlQueries.title: 4. Month-over-Month Revenue Growth (LAG() Window Function)
sqlQueries.description: Applies SQL LAG() to calculate month-over-month revenue differentials and velocity.
sqlQueries.query:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        YEAR(`OrderDate`) AS year,
        MONTH(`OrderDate`) AS month,
        SUM(`Revenue`) AS revenue
    FROM ecommerce_data
    GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    revenue,
    LAG(revenue) OVER(ORDER BY year, month) AS previous_month_revenue,
    revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER(ORDER BY year, month) AS revenue_growth,
    ROUND(((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER(ORDER BY year, month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER(ORDER BY year, month)) * 100, 2) AS growth_percentage
FROM monthly_sales
ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC
LIMIT 6;

sqlQueries.title: 5. Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & High-Value Buyers
sqlQueries.description: Calculates cumulative spending and repeat order metrics to segment VIP accounts.
sqlQueries.query:
SELECT 
    `CustomerID`,
    COUNT(`OrderID`) AS total_orders,
    SUM(`Revenue`) AS lifetime_value,
    ROUND(AVG(`Revenue`), 2) AS avg_ticket_size
FROM ecommerce_data
GROUP BY `CustomerID`
ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC
LIMIT 5;

sqlQueries.title: 6. Return Friction & Lost Revenue by Product Line
sqlQueries.description: Quantifies returned merchandise rates and dollar loss per merchandise category.
sqlQueries.query:
SELECT 
    `Product Category`,
    COUNT(`OrderID`) AS total_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `Status` = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_orders,
    ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN `Status` = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(`OrderID`)), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN `Status` = 'Returned' THEN `Revenue` ELSE 0 END), 2) AS lost_revenue
FROM ecommerce_data
GROUP BY `Product Category`
ORDER BY lost_revenue DESC;

executiveInsights.title: 27% Return Rate Driving $36.6M in Lost Gross Merchandise Value
executiveInsights.finding: Over 27% of all processed orders were returned, representing more than $36.6M in reversed transactions. The #1 driver is 'Product - Not fitting expectation' (42%) followed by 'Onsite - Description mismatch' (34%).
executiveInsights.recommendation: Deploy high-resolution 360° product photography, verified customer sizing guides, and mandatory specification audits on third-party seller listings to reduce description mismatch by an estimated 15-20%.

executiveInsights.title: RFM Segmentation Reveals High Potential in 'Potential Loyalists'
executiveInsights.finding: Potential Loyalists represent 28.4% of customer accounts with recent purchases but single or low frequency. Converting just 10% into Loyal Customers would boost annual recurring revenue by $4.8M.
executiveInsights.recommendation: Implement an automated 14-day post-purchase triggered email sequence offering complementary category cross-sell discounts and personalized product recommendations based on first purchase.

executiveInsights.title: Zone 3 Accounts for 43.2% of Total Sales Volume
executiveInsights.finding: Zone 3 generated $58.6M of total revenue, but average delivery times for standard delivery in this zone lag behind Zone 1 by 3.2 days, contributing to lower customer satisfaction ratings (2.68 vs 2.82).
executiveInsights.recommendation: Establish a regional distribution hub or 3PL micro-fulfillment facility in the Ashanti/Western regional nexus to cut Zone 3 fulfillment transit by 48 hours and reduce shipping overhead.

executiveInsights.title: Health & Beauty and Fashion Generate 63.4% of Total Revenue
executiveInsights.finding: The catalog is heavily concentrated in Health and Beauty ($44.7M) and Fashion ($41.3M). Blood pressure monitors and children's fashion sneakers are high-velocity anchor products with steady year-round demand.
executiveInsights.recommendation: Negotiate volume supplier discounts and establish vendor-managed inventory (VMI) for the top 20 Health & Beauty items to protect gross margin against supply chain fluctuations.
